## Life Summary

Isabella Lucieton Telfer was the third child of John Telfer and Martha Clara Henstridge. Born at Edgerston, South Australia on 17 July 1880, she married Alexander Brown Thomson on 12 July 1911. She lived to the age of 83, passing on 30 June 1964 at Klemzig, South Australia. Her death place — Klemzig, a north-eastern suburb of Adelaide — suggests she may have moved closer to the city in her later years, possibly to be nearer to family.

**Note:** Her records must be distinguished from other Isabella Thomsons of the same era — an Isabella Thomson who died in Western Australia (Karrakatta) in 1936, and a Scottish Isabella Thomson who died in Polmont in 1935. The 1964 Klemzig death date is the correct match for the Tantanoola Telfer line.

## Family Stories

Isabella Lucieton Telfer was the eighth child of John and Martha Telfer. She married Alexander Thomson, and together they had three children — Roma, Trevor and Murray. Her life, like that of many of her siblings, was rooted in the Tantanoola district where the Telfer family had established themselves after arriving from Scotland.

*(From the Borders to the Bush, p.240)*
